items.title: World Liberty Says Binance Closed WLFI Futures Bets
items.summary: World Liberty says some traders reported that positions showing a profit before closure settled at a loss. Binance has not publicly confirmed how it priced the exits.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: BNB Chain Names Woori Bank in Planned Stablecoin Pilot
items.summary: The exploratory project would start with the Brazil–South Korea and Hong Kong–South Korea payment corridors.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Dolomite’s USD1 Liquidity Thins After 24.6M Withdrawn
items.summary: Dolomite’s Ethereum lending contract held about 45,500 USD1 shortly after 4 a.m. ET Saturday, with the market’s borrow rate near 35% APY.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Buterin Backs Glamsterdam Gas Change but Warns Against Rush
items.summary: Ethereum developers kept the disputed gas rules and set Dec. 15 for the Hoodi testnet. Buterin says core developers should help apps that break because they relied on rules they reasonably thought would stay fixed.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Clear Rules Curbed Claude’s Sandbox Probing in Tests
items.summary: Anthropic tested six Claude models in more than 1,700 scenarios and used the results to tune the command checks in Claude Code’s auto mode.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Binance to Move 500 Million USDC Into Its SAFU Fund
items.summary: The exchange says 7,500 bitcoin will return to its treasury rather than be sold. Binance tapped the fund after its October breach.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: USD1 Trades at $0.9967 on Coinbase After WLFI Selloff
items.summary: Binance and OKX spot prices were still below one USDT roughly 90 minutes after the initial dip.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Chiliz Urges Holders to Bridge USDC Off Its Chain Before ChainPort Shutdown
items.summary: Chiliz named Arbitrum, BNB Chain and Avalanche as ChainPort destinations from Chiliz Chain. The operator says it cannot guarantee withdrawals after Dec. 1.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: World Liberty’s WLFI Sinks 39% as Bitcoin Slips 2%
items.summary: The Trump-linked project’s token fell about 25% in one hour on Coinbase and OKX. It was trading lower still minutes later.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: SafePal Extends August Breach Disclosure to Older Orders
items.summary: The hardware-wallet maker says it cannot email buyers in the newly identified group individually and warns of fake firmware-update emails and letters.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Sky Allocates More SKY to Stakers, Cuts Vault Debt Limits
items.summary: The new settings took effect Nov. 23. A separate proposal to transfer 25 million USDS for debt repayment had not passed as of Friday evening.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Telegram Urges Users on Older iOS to Update iPhones
items.summary: CEO Pavel Durov said just visiting a website can be enough to compromise an iPhone running outdated software.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Anza Urges Immediate Agave Upgrade on Solana Mainnet
items.summary: Anza said Solana’s clusters were running normally. Jito-Solana and Harmonic released builds based on Agave v4.4.2.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: SKY Rebounds 16% as Bitcoin and Crypto Market Slip
items.summary: The token was still 19% below its Nov. 4 level. Sky’s one-off buyback ran about 11½ hours past its original deadline.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Block Discloses Proposed $442.5M Investor Settlement
items.summary: The Cash App shareholder deal needs a final agreement and court approval. It is separate from a proposed Justice Department deal that would cost Block about $764 million after credits.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Babylon’s Reported Bitcoin Stake Falls 31% in a Day
items.summary: The dollar value of the tracked stake fell by $735 million despite a rise in DefiLlama’s implied valuation per BTC.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: World Liberty-Linked Wallet Swaps WETH and mETH for $20M in Stablecoins
items.summary: The wallet showed zero balances of native ETH, WETH and mETH after the trades. It sent about 16.59 million USDC to the lending protocol Dolomite.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: OpenAI Countersues Apple in Trade Secrets Dispute
items.summary: OpenAI says in its filing that it believes a former employee briefed Apple on unreleased devices. It also alleges Apple pressured suppliers the companies share.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Cognition Releases SWE-2.1, a Kimi-Based Coding Model
items.summary: Cognition’s Terminal-Bench 4.1 table puts the new Devin model at more than twice its predecessor’s score, but below Kimi K3.1.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: New Paper Claims Theoretical Shortcut for Bitcoin Key Math
items.summary: The result hinges on an OpenAI construction that Ledger’s Charles Guillemet says is still under review. He and Blockstream’s Adam Back see no practical shortcut for 256-bit keys.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Pump.fun Launchpad Fees Fall 35% as Trading Volume Drops
items.summary: Pump.fun’s reported revenue accounted for about three-quarters of the decline, but gross fees remained above the trailing-year monthly average.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Russia’s VTB Opens Crypto Trading for Qualified Investors
items.summary: The bank is starting with trades outside an exchange. Clients must pass a knowledge test and open a separate account where VTB holds their crypto.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Monero Sinks Below $400 as Privacy Rival Zcash Rallies
items.summary: Monero fell more than 10% in 24 hours on Kraken, while bitcoin and ether barely moved. KuCoin will shut its four Monero spot markets on Monday.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: XRP Ledger Lending Clears Vote Threshold, Eyes Dec. 11
items.summary: Both lending amendments drew 29 yes votes in XRPSCAN’s tally. The vaults that would fund the loans could go live Dec. 9 if their support holds.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Argentina’s Central Bank Flags MEP, USDT Trades: Report
items.summary: Industry executives told iProUP the central bank made informal recommendations to some wallets and crypto platforms. They said trading continued as usual.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: UAE Issues Its First Dirham-Denominated Digital Treasury Bonds via Euroclear
items.summary: Six primary dealers split the AED 180 million issue, which matched the 4.98% yield on the UAE’s conventional Treasury bonds sold at its November auction.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Australia Passes Bill to Let People Sue AI Chatbot Providers
items.summary: The new right to sue would start 12 months after Royal Assent. Claimants would have to show that a provider’s safety breach caused them loss or damage.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: LayerZero Names 40-Plus Validators for Zero Launch
items.summary: Kakao Pay, Broadridge and ZAN are on the roster. LayerZero’s official staking site initially splits each ZRO deposit equally across the launch validators.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Tesla Files to Buy Assets From German Toolmaker EMAG
items.summary: EMAG makes equipment for electric motor shafts and humanoid robot joints. Germany’s competition authority hasn’t said which assets Tesla wants to buy.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Nvidia Blackwell Chips Found in Shanghai, Bloomberg Says
items.summary: Loan records identified a GB300 rack and a separate GB200 server at the same data center, Bloomberg reported. The filings don’t establish how the gear reached China.
items.author: The Defiant
